conviction_note: Scale is the 13.4% option-implied event move (indicative, ATM spread 80% of mid), backed by the name's own last three prints (-11% Q3 2025, about +15% Q1 2026, -15 to -19% Q2 2026), all moved by the guide. p_up is 45, not lower: the one new fact, Qfin's Q4 guide of 24 Nov (volume -20% QoQ, profit -67 to -77% YoY), points to a cut or a soft hold of FINV's FY guide, but FINV already fell 5.4% on 25 Nov and 10.7% over five sessions to a 52-week low, so much of that read-through has been sold already. The FY low end (RMB11.5bn) already assumes H2 revenue about 26% below H1, and the buyback headroom is real. The findings sum to -0.3; the scaled number is -1.3. The two agree in sign and both are small next to the 13-point scale, because the evidence is mostly two-sided.
bar: There is no sourced Q3 consensus. Search found only a pre-August FY revenue consensus of $1.85bn on Seeking Alpha (https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/FINV/earnings/estimates, page dated 2026-03-27, now stale) and Investing.com saying the Q2 forecast was not shown. The bar used is the company's own FY2026 revenue guide of RMB11.5-12.9bn, reiterated 2026-08-27 with management steering to 'the lower part of the range unless the operating environment substantially changes' (https://www.financialcontent.com/article/gnwcq-2026-8-27-finvolution-group-reports-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results ; call: https://www.webull.com/news/15496818263843840). H1 revenue was about RMB6.61bn (Q1 about 3.21bn plus Q2 3.403bn), so the low end implies H2 of about RMB4.89bn, about 2.44bn a quarter, against Q2's 3.40bn. print_vs_bar_pct is my read that FY revenue implied by the new commentary lands about 1% below the RMB11.5bn low end. Quarter-level findings are capped small because the Q3 bar is unsourced.
positioning_check: Short interest: about 4.1m ADS at the FINRA 2026-09-30 settlement, 3.5 days to cover, down from 5.0m and 3.9 days two weeks earlier (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/finv/short-interest/). Fintel shows 4.87m and 16.07 days, undated (https://fintel.io/ss/us/finv). Both are a low share of a roughly 245m+ ADS float, so this is not a crowded short and gives no squeeze mechanism of note. Options: skew_25d is null in the baseline, so the option market gives no stated direction. Put/call open interest is 0.17 (call-heavy) on 9,611 contracts, and the ATM spread is 80% of mid, so the implied move is indicative only. Tape: spot $2.331 is at the 52-week low, -62% from the high, -17.6% over 20 days and -10.7% over 5 days. It fell 5.4% intraday on 2026-11-25, the session after Qfin's release (https://www.aaii.com/investingideas/article/538816-why-finvolution-group8217s-finv-stock-is-down-538). Analysts: Citi cut to Hold/Neutral with a $4.10 target on 2026-08-28; Jefferies kept Buy at $4.70. The reaction session is Friday 2026-11-27, a 13:00 ET half day after Thanksgiving, so liquidity will be thin.

findings.finding: Qfin is the largest US-listed peer, with the same funding and collection exposure. It reported Q3 2026 on 2026-11-24, after FINV last spoke on 08-27. Q3 loan volume was RMB49.5bn, -40.6% YoY. Revenue was RMB3.09bn, -13.4% QoQ. It guided Q4 non-GAAP net income to RMB250-350m (-67% to -77% YoY) and Q4 volume to about -20% QoQ. Management said liquidity will tighten further over the next one or two quarters as ABS issuance costs rise. It said regulatory uncertainty persists into 2027, the 30-day collection rate of 86% is near historic lows and will not return to 88%, and 'a 3% take rate is impossible to maintain' (FINV's own China take rate was about 3.2% in Q2). The read-through is that FINV's FY revenue guide (low end RMB11.5bn) and its Q4/2027 commentary are more likely to be cut or softened than reaffirmed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FINV trades on the guide. Q2 2026 (2026-08-27): the FY guide was steered to the low end and the stock fell about 15-19% (https://www.quiverquant.com/news/FinVolution+Group+Reports+Second+Quarter+2026+Financial+Results+and+Reaffirms+Full Year+Revenue+Guidance ; sweep row cites ainvest -15%). Q1 2026: the outlook was reaffirmed with a new US$150m buyback and the stock rose about 15% (sweep row, secondary). Q3 2025 (2025-11-20): -11% intraday, the largest fall since March 2023 (https://www.itiger.com/hant/news/2585151253).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. FINV fell 5.4% intraday on 11-25 and 10.7% over five sessions, and QFIN's own reaction is reported between -2% and -12% depending on the snapshot. What would look different if this were fully priced: FINV would have fallen about as far as QFIN on the day, rather than half as far, and sell-side FY numbers would already sit below the RMB11.5bn low end. No post-Qfin FINV estimate revision was found, and Citi's $4.10 target from August is still the latest cut found.
findings.independence: Qfin's release itself: https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/11/25/tmt-newswire/globenewswire/qfin-holdings-announces-third-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results/2477629 (same company, same event: one finding). A different counterparty pointing the same way: LexinFintech's Q2 release of 2026-08-31 guided Q3 originations to fall significantly QoQ with a possible net loss, and blamed the late-June peer risk event that tightened sector funding (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001708259/000119312526375383/lx-ex99_1.htm).

findings.finding: From FINV's own Q2 call: China transaction volume was 'down around 50% in July'. China funding cost rose 30bp QoQ to 3.7% with another 30bp in July. Collection capacity 'took a bit of a hit' after the late-July regulatory action on collection, and early risk indicators were up about 20% versus Q2. The release said 'we anticipate a considerable contraction in transaction volume in China' for Q3. So the reported Q3 will show a deep China volume drop, rising funding costs and worse early credit. All of this sits inside what the company already told the market.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The reported-quarter lines have not decided FINV's last prints; the guide has (see the first finding). In Q2 2026, revenue up 6% QoQ and net profit up 1% QoQ did not stop a 15-19% fall on the guide.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The company guided to it three months ago and the stock is down 62% from its high. It is filed because the size of the credit deterioration (C-M2, 90+ DPD, provisions) relative to the guided contraction is not public. Qfin's C-M2 rose from 0.66% to 0.81% and its provisions rose QoQ. A similar step at FINV would be the only part not already in the price.
findings.independence: Qfin's Q3 credit data shows the same direction: day-1 delinquency 5.6% to 5.8%, C-M2 0.66% to 0.81%, collection rate 88.1% to 86% (https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/earnings-call-transcript-qfin-holdings-posts-weak-q3-2026-results-as-growth-slows-93CH-5002961). It shares that document with the first finding but makes a different point (credit, not the guide).

findings.finding: FINV's FY guide low end already builds in a severe H2. H1 revenue was about RMB6.61bn (Q2 RMB3,403m, Q1 about 3,210m), so the RMB11.5bn low end needs only about RMB4.89bn in H2, about 2.44bn a quarter, or -28% against Q2. Qfin's revenue fell only 13.4% QoQ on a roughly 22% QoQ volume drop (Q2 63.4bn to Q3 49.5bn), because facilitation revenue lags volume. On that basis FINV can plausibly hold or narrowly touch the low end even after a 50% July China volume drop, so a reaffirmed low end is a live outcome, not a remote one.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last time the guide was reaffirmed outright (Q1 2026, with a buyback), the stock rose about 15% (sweep row). Steering to the low end (Q2) fell 15-19%. A hold of the low end from a 52-week low after a peer's shock guide is untested.
findings.why_not_priced: The market appears to have extrapolated Qfin's Q4 profit guide (-67 to -77%) onto FINV (-5.4% on 11-25). FINV's guide is a revenue range whose low end already implies a step down of more than a quarter. If the market had done this arithmetic, FINV would not have sold off on a peer read when its own guide already sits at a level that a Qfin-like revenue path roughly meets.
findings.independence: Qfin Q2 2026 volume of RMB63.4bn and revenue of RMB3.57bn, for the QoQ comparison (search summary of Qfin's Q2 release; Q3 from https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/11/25/tmt-newswire/globenewswire/qfin-holdings-announces-third-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results/2477629). It uses the same Qfin documents as the first finding but argues the opposite question (can FINV meet its own range), so it is a counterweight, not a duplicate. My own estimate (inference): FINV Q3 revenue of about RMB2.75-2.9bn leaves about RMB2.0-2.1bn needed in Q4.

findings.finding: Capital return headroom: FINV held cash of RMB3.26bn plus short-term investments of RMB3.16bn (about US$946m) at 2026-06-30, with leverage of 2.1x 'around historic lows'. Its fifth buyback program, up to US$150m, runs 2026-05-30 to 2028-05-29, and only US$27.4m was repurchased in Q2. The dividend policy pays 20-30% of prior-year net income. With the ADS at a 52-week low of $2.33, Q3 repurchase pace or a step-up/new authorisation at the print is a lever. The counterweight is that Qfin said on 11-24 it will take a 'more prudent approach to capital deployment', so FINV may slow buybacks rather than speed them up. The size is net of that.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026: the new US$150m buyback with a reaffirmed guide gave about +15% (sweep row, secondary), with the buyback and the guide not separable.
findings.why_not_priced: A stock trading at a 52-week low, 62% off its high, with US$946m of cash and short-term investments on its June balance sheet, is not being valued on capital return. If the market expected an accelerated buyback, the call-heavy open interest (put/call 0.17) would have shown up in the price rather than leaving the stock at its low.
findings.independence: Q2 release cash and leverage figures: https://www.financialcontent.com/article/gnwcq-2026-8-27-finvolution-group-reports-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results. Dividend policy: https://finvolution.gcs-web.com/stock/dividend-and-shares-repurchase-history. Against it: Qfin's capital-prudence remark (https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/11/25/tmt-newswire/globenewswire/qfin-holdings-announces-third-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results/2477629).

findings.finding: Indonesia (more than 50% of FINV overseas volume and revenue; overseas was 27% of group revenue in Q2) worsened in Q3. OJK data put industry fintech-lending TWP90 at 5.36% in September 2026, against 4.32% in July and 2.82% a year earlier. Industry outstanding slipped from Rp106.94tn (August) to Rp106.48tn (September). Net of the company: AdaKami self-reports a 0% TWP90 and loan rejections as its top complaint, and part of the industry spike is attributed to two fraud-hit platforms. The 30% debt-to-income cap also limits growth.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Overseas growth was the positive leg in the Q2 release (overseas operating profit more than doubled, unique borrowers +130%) and did not offset the guide-driven fall.
findings.why_not_priced: Indonesian-language OJK statistics are not in US wire copy on FINV. It is small because it is an industry proxy, and the company's own platform reports far better credit.

findings.finding: Relative position in the sector: smaller peers were already loss-making or guiding to losses. Jiayin posted a Q2 2026 net loss of RMB183.6m on RMB9.5bn of volume, and LexinFintech guided Q3 to a possible net loss. FINV earned RMB427m in Q2 with 90+ DPD of 2.10% and leverage of 2.1x. Qfin also said it expects smaller, lower-compliance platforms to exit and competition for customers to ease. So FINV printing a profitable Q3 in a contracting market is a relative-strength point that a shakeout could support.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not observed separately. Relative resilience did not protect the stock in Q2 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely public since August. It is filed because the consolidation argument (weaker platforms exit, funding concentrates) was restated by Qfin only on 11-24 and has not been applied to FINV, whose price trades as if it faces the same damage as the sector.
findings.independence: LexinFintech Q2 2026 release: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001708259/000119312526375383/lx-ex99_1.htm ; Qfin shakeout remark: https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/earnings-call-transcript-qfin-holdings-posts-weak-q3-2026-results-as-growth-slows-93CH-5002961

outside_window.finding: LexinFintech reports Q3 2026 after the US close on 2026-12-03, a further sector read that is too late for this window.

Regulatory path: on-balance-sheet lending must be priced at 4x LPR by end-2027, and further rules on market entry, partnership models and funding supply are under consideration (Qfin call). This weighs on the 2027 take rate beyond this window, except as far as FINV's own call commentary reflects it.

baseline_tension: The evidence agrees with the run-up: the stock is already down 17.6% over 20 days and 5.4% on the day of the peer's guide, and the main new fact (Qfin's Q4 guide) is negative. The skew is null and put/call open interest is call-heavy (0.17), so there is no option-market directional statement to beat. Because the negative read-through is partly sold already and the FY low end embeds a deep H2, p_up sits at 45, not lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (a finding inside what the company already guided): the Q3 China volume contraction finding (second finding) was cut from -0.5 to -0.3, because the company told the market in August to expect it.

Rule 9 (size a segment net of the rest) and rule 5 (proxy): the Indonesia OJK finding (fifth finding) was cut from -0.5 to -0.3, net of AdaKami's self-reported 0% TWP90 and the industry spike being partly two fraud-hit platforms.

Left standing: the peer-guide finding (-2.5). 'A peer's print landing after the company last spoke, leaving consensus stale' is the pattern the file lists as having paid. It was not enlarged, because the stock already fell 5.4% on it.
Rule 6 (unsourced bar): no Q3 consensus was found, so the bar is the company's FY guide, and quarter-level findings stay small (0.3 or less); the guide findings are sized on the guide scale.
